note: Expert code is not in this repository. It lives in the agent above in the Extella market; sha = first 12 hex of sha256 of the code. Versions with in_market=false were used by earlier runs only.

experts.name: zoo_game_plan
experts.description: A Month at the Zoo: turns the model's short plan for tomorrow (stock and staff lean|normal|safe; shows, ticket price, free Wednesday and card answers, or 'expert' to pick them by money) and the evening observation into the exact decision: thaw, feed orders, keeper shifts, hires, price, plus dollar estimates and warnings.

experts.name: zoo_month
experts.description: A Month at the Zoo, the whole game in one expert (world ny2 of extella.dev/zoo): replays the month so far, shows the current evening with the cards in words, applies a plan through zoo_game_plan and plays the next day; mode=check replays a full 30-evening log and returns the score for the leaderboard.
